{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue over ALL completed orders, including QA orders
mean_revenue_all_completed = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (including QA orders): {mean_revenue_all_completed}")

# Check how many QA orders are in the completed set
qa_count = (df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_count}")"}
